kpjue01.title: Aries Skips the Scenery
kpjue01.caption:
Date one: amazing. Date two: already planned, during date one.
Jupiter just wants Aries to enjoy the scenic route. Who in your life speedruns every crush?

kpjue02.title: Taurus Takes a New Seat
kpjue02.caption:
Comfort is good. Comfort on repeat can quietly keep love out.
Keep one familiar thing and change one small thing: same café, new seat, a hello. Save this for your next Saturday.

kpjue03.title: Gemini's Six Saturdays
kpjue03.caption:
Six group chats. Six Saturday plans. One Gemini who said yes to all of them.
When the planet of more says it's too much, it's too much. Which plan would you keep?

kpjue04.title: Jupiter Can't Fit Through Cancer's Door
kpjue04.caption:
Saying no to every invite after getting hurt makes sense. It also keeps the good things out.
One text back, one small yes. Home will still be there when you get back.

kpjue05.title: Two Giants, One Spotlight
kpjue05.caption:
Waiting to be asked out with a grand gesture? Jupiter has notes.
The biggest planet says the best move is going first with a kind word. Which Leo in your chat needs this?

kpjue06.title: Virgo's Very Long List
kpjue06.caption:
Ruling someone out over their shoes? That list might be doing too much.
Keep the dealbreakers and let the nitpicks go. Kind, honest and makes you laugh is a great start.
